MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 41
   C. 49
   D. 43

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/2

4. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 20

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 22
   C. 77
   D. 18

7. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 48
   D. 14

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 36

9. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 32
   D. 64

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

11. Solve for x: x + 9 = 20. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 9
   C. 11
   D. 20

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 26

13. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.205
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.025

14. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 105
   C. 30
   D. 22

16. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 73

17. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

18. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 122

19. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

20. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

21. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

22. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

23. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

24. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

25. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 82
   D. 18

26. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

27. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

28. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 12

29. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

30. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 32

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
